RANDA TOURS — 60 STORIES WEBSITE
NextWave Marketing website package | 13 October 2026

OPEN WEBSITE
Extract the ZIP and open index.html in your browser.
Pages: Home, Tours, Tour Detail, Destinations, Safaris, Transport, Experiences, About, Contact, Policies.

UPDATES
- 60 customer-review texts supplied by RandA Tours, with names, countries, tours and wording intact.
- Old placeholder review entries removed.
- Review cards display the business-provided text without editorial or verification-status badges.
- Homepage auto-rotating carousel with next / previous / pause.
- Experiences page with country / tour filters, search and load more.
- Existing animations, generated tour images, RandA logo and Facebook link retained.

REVIEW PROVENANCE
Feedback texts were supplied by the business for display, but independent authentication of guest identity, original feedback source and permission was not performed. No star ratings or verification claims have been added. Source text is in docs/RandA_60_Customer_Reviews_Source.txt.

BEFORE WEBSITE LAUNCH
- Enter the real WhatsApp number, email and phone in assets/js/config.js.
- Confirm public-use permission for each named customer and the review wording.
- Confirm live itinerary details, booking policies and any package inclusions.
- Illustrations for the tour cards are AI-generated travel concept images, not customer photographs.
- Domain, hosting and payment gateway are not included in this static website.


PRESENTATION UPDATE: The long provenance/disclosure paragraphs have been replaced with short, clearly marked illustrative-story labels on the homepage and Experiences page. Replace fictional samples with consented, genuine customer reviews before publishing publicly.

LATEST CHANGE: Removed website-visible sample/illustrative-story labels from the homepage and Experiences page. All 60 customer-approved reviews, carousel controls and filtering remain unchanged.


2026-10-13: Premium Black & Gold theme applied site-wide. Only styling / theme-color metadata changed. All tours, 60 reviews, filters, carousel, social links and animations remain in place.


NEXTWAVE ANIMATION UPGRADE (2026-10-13)
Existing black/gold design, pages, packages, images and reviews unchanged.
Motion-only additions: assets/css/motion-studio.css and assets/js/motion-studio.js.
Features: scroll pop-up/stagger reveal, card/photo hover shine, hero copy entrances,
review slide entrance polish and reduced-motion support. No unsolicited popup overlay.
